126	def verify_wheel_contents(wheel_path: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
127	    """Verify archive contents of a built wheel.
128	
129	    Raises ValueError if any required module, registry file, or marker is missing.
130	    """
131	    wheel_path = pathlib.Path(wheel_path).resolve()
132	    if not wheel_path.exists():
133	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Wheel does not exist: {wheel_path}")
134	
135	    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel_path, "r") as zf:
136	        namelist = set(zf.namelist())
137	
138	    missing_tui = [m for m in REQUIRED_TUI_MODULES if m not in namelist]
139	    if missing_tui:
140	        raise ValueError(
141	            f"Wheel archive {wheel_path.name} is missing required TUI module(s): {missing_tui!r}"
142	        )
143	
144	    registry_files = [
145	        n for n in namelist if n.startswith("skill_lens/registry/agents/") and n.endswith(".toml")
146	    ]
147	    if len(registry_files) != REQUIRED_REGISTRY_COUNT:
148	        raise ValueError(
149	            f"Wheel archive {wheel_path.name} contains {len(registry_files)} agent registry TOMLs; "
150	            f"expected exactly {REQUIRED_REGISTRY_COUNT}."
151	        )
152	
153	    if REQUIRED_TYPED_MARKER not in namelist:
154	        raise ValueError(
155	            f"Wheel archive {wheel_path.name} is missing typing marker: {REQUIRED_TYPED_MARKER}"
156	        )
157	
158	    return {
159	        "wheel": str(wheel_path.resolve()),
160	        "sha256": compute_sha256(wheel_path),
161	        "tui_modules": list(REQUIRED_TUI_MODULES),
162	        "registry_count": len(registry_files),
163	        "registry_files": sorted(registry_files),
164	        "typed_marker": True,
165	        "total_files": len(namelist),
166	    }

169	def verify_sdist_contents(sdist_path: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
170	    """Verify archive contents of a built sdist tarball.
171	
172	    Raises ValueError if required root or package files are missing.
173	    """
174	    sdist_path = pathlib.Path(sdist_path).resolve()
175	    if not sdist_path.exists():
176	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Sdist does not exist: {sdist_path}")
177	
178	    with tarfile.open(sdist_path, "r:*") as tf:
179	        names = tf.getnames()
180	
181	    # Sdist archives prefix entries with '<pkg>-<version>/'
182	    prefix = ""
183	    for name in names:
184	        if name.endswith("pyproject.toml"):
185	            prefix = name[: -len("pyproject.toml")]
186	            break
187	
188	    missing: list[str] = []
189	    for required in ("pyproject.toml", "README.md", "LICENSE", REQUIRED_TYPED_MARKER):
190	        target = f"{prefix}{required}"
191	        if target not in names:
192	            missing.append(required)
193	
194	    for mod in REQUIRED_TUI_MODULES:
195	        target = f"{prefix}{mod}"
196	        if target not in names:
197	            missing.append(mod)
198	
199	    if missing:
200	        raise ValueError(
201	            f"Sdist archive {sdist_path.name} is missing required file(s): {missing!r}"
202	        )
203	
204	    registry_files = [
205	        n for n in names if f"{prefix}skill_lens/registry/agents/" in n and n.endswith(".toml")
206	    ]
207	    if len(registry_files) != REQUIRED_REGISTRY_COUNT:
208	        raise ValueError(
209	            f"Sdist archive {sdist_path.name} contains {len(registry_files)} agent registry TOMLs; "
210	            f"expected exactly {REQUIRED_REGISTRY_COUNT}."
211	        )
212	
213	    return {
214	        "sdist": str(sdist_path.resolve()),
215	        "sha256": compute_sha256(sdist_path),
216	        "prefix": prefix,
217	        "tui_modules": list(REQUIRED_TUI_MODULES),
218	        "registry_count": len(registry_files),
219	        "total_files": len(names),
220	    }

223	def _clean_env(home_dir: pathlib.Path) -> dict[str, str]:
224	    """Create a pristine environment dictionary outside user home and repo."""
225	    env = {

228	        "XDG_CONFIG_HOME": str(home_dir / ".config"),
229	        "XDG_DATA_HOME": str(home_dir / ".local" / "share"),

235	        env.pop(key, None)

169	def _selected_node_missing(selections: Iterable[str], root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> list[str]:
170	    """Return the selections whose test file or test function is absent under ``root``.
171	
172	    A selected node ID that no longer exists makes pytest exit with "no tests ran"
173	    only after a slow cold install, so the selection is checked statically first.

198	    for node in ast.parse(source).body:

624	def _make_packaging_subprocess_runner(
625	    *,
626	    base_provenance: str | None = None,
627	    endpoint_pkg_provenance: str | None = None,
628	    endpoint_tui_provenance: str | None = None,
629	    simulate_textual_in_base: bool = False,
630	    pytest_returncode: int = 0,
631	    pytest_stdout: str = "================ 10 passed in 0.1s ================\n",
632	    pytest_stderr: str = "",
633	    captured_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
634	    pytest_timeout: bool = False,
635	    pytest_partial_bytes: bool = False,
636	) -> Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]]:
637	    """Create a deterministic subprocess runner double for installed lane packaging tests.
638	
639	    With ``pytest_timeout=True`` the ``pytest`` invocation raises
640	    ``subprocess.TimeoutExpired`` after the earlier install/provenance calls,
641	    simulating an exceeded suite run. The partial output is bytes when
642	    ``pytest_partial_bytes=True`` and str otherwise.
643	    """
644	
645	    def mock_subprocess_run(
646	        cmd: list[str], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any
647	    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
648	        cwd = kwargs.get("cwd")
649	        if captured_calls is not None:
650	            captured_calls.append({"cmd": list(cmd), "cwd": cwd, "env": kwargs.get("env")})
651	
652	        # Check for wheel references in the command
653	        for arg in cmd:
654	            if "skill_lens_cli" in arg:
655	                # Strip extras if present (e.g. "...whl[tui]")
656	                wheel_part = arg.split("[")[0] if "[" in arg else arg
657	                target = Path(wheel_part)
658	                # If target is relative, the subprocess resolves it relative to cwd
659	                lookup_path = (
660	                    target if target.is_absolute() else (Path(cwd) / target if cwd else target)
661	                )
662	                if not lookup_path.exists():
663	                    raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(
664	                        1,
665	                        cmd,
666	                        output="",
667	                        stderr=f"File not found from subprocess cwd {cwd}: {lookup_path}",
668	                    )
669	
670	        # Mock standard subprocess responses expected by smoke_wheel
671	        cmd_exe = Path(cmd[0]).name if cmd else ""
672	
673	        if cmd_exe == "uv":
674	            if "list" in cmd:
675	                list_json = json.dumps(
676	                    [
677	                        {"name": "skill-lens-cli", "version": "0.1.1"},
678	                        {"name": "textual", "version": "8.2.8"},
679	                    ]
680	                )
681	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout=list_json, stderr="")
682	            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="", stderr="")
683	
684	        if cmd_exe.startswith("python"):
685	            if "-c" in cmd:
686	                code_arg = cmd[cmd.index("-c") + 1]
687	                if "skill_lens.__file__" in code_arg:
688	                    default_venv = Path(cwd) / "venv" if cwd else Path("/dummy/venv")
689	                    default_site = (
690	                        default_venv / "lib" / "python3.11" / "site-packages" / "skill_lens"
691	                    )
692	                    if "skill_lens.tui" in code_arg:
693	                        pkg_p = (
694	                            endpoint_pkg_provenance
695	                            if endpoint_pkg_provenance is not None
696	                            else str(default_site / "__init__.py")
697	                        )
698	                        tui_p = (
699	                            endpoint_tui_provenance
700	                            if endpoint_tui_provenance is not None
701	                            else str(default_site / "tui" / "__init__.py")
702	                        )
703	                        out = f"{pkg_p}\n{tui_p}\n"
704	                        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout=out, stderr="")
705	                    pkg_p = (
706	                        base_provenance
707	                        if base_provenance is not None
708	                        else str(default_site / "__init__.py")
709	                    )
710	                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout=f"{pkg_p}\n", stderr="")
711	                if "find_spec('textual')" in code_arg:
712	                    if simulate_textual_in_base:
713	                        res = _REAL_SUBPROCESS_RUN(
714	                            [sys.executable, "-c", code_arg],
715	                            capture_output=True,
716	                            text=True,
717	                        )
718	                        if res.returncode != 0:
719	                            raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(
720	                                res.returncode, cmd, output=res.stdout, stderr=res.stderr
721	                            )
722	                        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
723	                            cmd, 0, stdout=res.stdout, stderr=res.stderr
724	                        )
725	                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="", stderr="")
726	                if "textual.__version__" in code_arg:
727	                    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="8.2.8\n", stderr="")
728	            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="", stderr="")
729	
730	        if cmd_exe == "skill-lens":
731	            if len(cmd) == 1:
732	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
733	                    cmd, 0, stdout="Usage: skill-lens [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...\n", stderr=""
734	                )
735	            if "--version" in cmd:
736	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="skill-lens 0.1.1\n", stderr="")
737	            if "--help" in cmd:
738	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
739	                    cmd, 0, stdout="Usage: skill-lens [OPTIONS]\n", stderr=""
740	                )
741	            if cmd[1:] == ["tui"]:
742	                if cwd and "base_lane" in str(cwd):
743	                    msg = (
744	                        "Error: The 'tui' command requires the optional [tui] extra. "
745	                        "Install with: pip install 'skill-lens-cli[tui]'\n"
746	                    )
747	                else:
748	                    msg = "Error: The terminal UI requires an interactive terminal.\n"
749	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 2, stdout="", stderr=msg)
750	
751	        if cmd_exe == "pytest":
752	            if pytest_timeout:
753	                stdout_partial: str | bytes = (
754	                    b"PARTIAL SUITE STDOUT" if pytest_partial_bytes else "PARTIAL SUITE STDOUT"
755	                )
756	                stderr_partial: str | bytes = (
757	                    b"PARTIAL SUITE STDERR" if pytest_partial_bytes else "PARTIAL SUITE STDERR"
758	                )
759	                raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(
760	                    list(cmd),
761	                    timeout=kwargs.get("timeout"),
762	                    output=stdout_partial,
763	                    stderr=stderr_partial,
764	                )
765	            if pytest_returncode != 0:
766	                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(
767	                    cmd, pytest_returncode, stdout=pytest_stdout, stderr=pytest_stderr
768	                )
769	            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout=pytest_stdout, stderr=pytest_stderr)
770	
771	        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(cmd, 0, stdout="", stderr="")
772	
773	    return mock_subprocess_run

776	def test_expanded_installed_selection_reaches_the_real_pytest_command(
777	    tmp_path: Path, mock_home: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
778	) -> None:
779	    """Every U9 selection must reach the lane's own pytest argv, unfiltered.
780	
781	    The runner builds its own command list, so a narrowing option (``-k``,
782	    ``--deselect``, ``--ignore`` …) or a hand-trimmed list could drop the new
783	    browsing/parity cases while the lane still reports success. This drives the
784	    real command builder through a deterministic subprocess double and reads back
785	    the argv it would execute.
786	    """
